retained: Long drawPaint replays yield to a MessageChannel task between strokes after approximately 12 ms. Scratch surfaces remain private and preserve per-stroke order; viewport presentation still waits for the finished frame. Ports close before continuation.
tradeoff: The observed 60 ms main-thread task disappeared in both final switching trials. First cold switch increased from 68 ms to 81.4/86.5 ms; warm medians remained 11.7/12 ms. Prioritize input handling during the replay rather than presenting this as faster completion.
rejected_trials: Cropped drawImage source rectangles changed low-alpha channel values by up to 6 and were rejected. Destination clipping retained exact pixels; clipping plus dirty-region clearing measured 62.7/69.8 ms cold switches versus 68 ms before, without a consistent gain. Both were removed.
correctness: Reference now uses fresh per-stroke surfaces and full-canvas composition, including pressure-sensitive tiny pencils at 800% zoom. A real Pencil button update is asserted before a 96-stroke cold replay finishes.
validation: 702 unit tests and 30 selected browser cases passed; exact pixels, Clone/raster erasure, clipboard, history and active-stroke regressions included.
limitations: Best-effort yielding only between strokes. One very expensive stroke/native operation can still exceed the budget. Small-script startup, dense Pen, broader devices/GPU and remaining cold-operation work remain open.
